en: Sepia-toned portrait of a woman in elaborate 18th‑century style stage costume: a voluminous striped gown with ruffles and floral decorations, and a large feathered wig-like headdress. She holds a fan in front of her. The background is dark and indistinct, typical of a studio or theatrical setting. White text at the top right identifies her and the role, and small text at the bottom right credits the photographer and city with a date.
